title: 完璧归赵
script: next-video/wanbi/script_v2.md, the 旁白 column: 23 lines, 367 字
about: speakers = who may speak a quote: keys of PEOPLE in src/videos/wanbi/people.ts (lin = 蔺相如 the envoy, qinWang = 秦王 the King of Qin).

quotes = a character's own words inside the line, in order (the lip-sync lines: the envoy at 6, 9, 11, 14, 18, 19; the King of Qin at 12, 21). who = a key of speakers, name = the role, text = the words exactly as in the line, punctuation included (without the quote marks). scripts/wanbi/gen_timing.py checks them against its CAP table and writes QUOTE_RAW.

lines.text: 宦官的门客蔺相如，举着和氏璧要往柱子上撞。
lines.en: The envoy has one job: deliver the world's most precious jade. He's about to smash it.
lines.source: 為趙宦者令繆賢舍人……相如持其璧睨柱，欲以擊柱

lines.text: 对面急得直摆手的，是秦王。
lines.en: And the one begging him to stop? The King of Qin, who's supposed to receive it.
lines.source: 秦王恐其破璧，乃辭謝固請

lines.text: 这块玉，秦王开价十五座城。
lines.en: The king had offered the kingdom of Zhao fifteen cities for it.
lines.source: 願以十五城請易璧

lines.text: 赵国给了，城可能不来；不给，秦兵一定来。
lines.en: Hand it over, and the cities may never come. Refuse, and Qin's army definitely will.
lines.source: 欲予秦，秦城恐不可得，徒見欺；欲勿予，即患秦兵之來

lines.text: 派谁去？没人。最后，宦官把自家门客推了出来。
lines.en: Who could Zhao send? Nobody. Until a palace eunuch put forward his own retainer.
lines.source: 求人可使報秦者，未得。宦者令繆賢曰：「臣舍人藺相如可使。」

lines.text: 他说：“我去。城不来，我把玉完整带回来。”

quotes.name: 蔺相如
quotes.text: 我去。城不来，我把玉完整带回来。

lines.en: He says: "I'll go. No cities, and I bring the jade back in one piece."
lines.source: 臣願奉璧往使。城入趙而璧留秦；城不入，臣請完璧歸趙

lines.text: 秦王接过玉，乐坏了，传给美人们看。
lines.en: The king takes the jade, thrilled, and passes it round to his ladies.
lines.source: 秦王坐章臺見相如……秦王大喜，傳以示美人及左右

lines.text: 满屋子喊万岁，没人提城的事。
lines.en: Everyone shouts "Long live the king!" Nobody mentions the cities.
lines.source: 左右皆呼萬歲。相如視秦王無意償趙城

lines.text: 他走上前：“这玉有个瑕疵，我指给大王看。”

quotes.name: 蔺相如
quotes.text: 这玉有个瑕疵，我指给大王看。

lines.en: He steps forward: "There's a flaw in it. Let me show Your Majesty."
lines.source: 乃前曰：「璧有瑕，請指示王。」

lines.text: 玉一到手，他退到柱子边，怒发冲冠。
lines.en: The second it's back in his hands, he backs against a pillar, so furious his hair lifts his hat.
lines.source: 王授璧，相如因持璧卻立，倚柱，怒髪上沖冠

lines.text: “再逼我，我的头和这块玉，一起碎在柱子上！”

quotes.name: 蔺相如
quotes.text: 再逼我，我的头和这块玉，一起碎在柱子上！

lines.en: "Push me, and my head and this jade shatter on this pillar together!"
lines.source: 大王必欲急臣，臣頭今與璧俱碎於柱矣！

lines.text: 秦王赶紧道歉，摊开地图一指：“这十五座城，给赵国。”
lines.en: The king apologises at once, unrolls a map and points: "These fifteen cities. Zhao's."
lines.source: 乃辭謝固請，召有司案圖，指從此以往十五都予趙

lines.text: 他看得出来，秦王在演。
lines.en: He can tell the king is acting.
lines.source: 相如度秦王特以詐詳為予趙城，實不可得

lines.text: 他也演：“赵王斋戒五天才送玉，大王也得斋戒五天，摆上大礼，我才交。”

quotes.name: 蔺相如
quotes.text: 赵王斋戒五天才送玉，大王也得斋戒五天，摆上大礼，我才交。

lines.en: So he acts too: "My king fasted five days before sending it. Your Majesty fasts five days and holds the grand ceremony, then I hand it over."
lines.source: 趙王送璧時，齋戒五日，今大王亦宜齋戒五日，設九賓於廷，臣乃敢上璧

lines.text: 秦王抢不到，只好答应。
lines.en: The king can't just grab it, so he agrees.
lines.source: 秦王度之，終不可彊奪，遂許齋五日

lines.text: 转头，他让随从穿上粗布衣服，揣着玉，抄小路溜回赵国。
lines.en: Meanwhile he dresses a servant in rough cloth, the jade tucked in his coat, and sends him home by the back roads.
lines.source: 乃使其從者衣褐，懷其璧，從徑道亡，歸璧于趙

lines.text: 五天后，大礼摆好，秦王要玉。
lines.en: Five days later the ceremony is set. The king asks for the jade.
lines.source: 秦王齋五日後，乃設九賓禮於廷，引趙使者藺相如

lines.text: 他说：“秦国二十多个国君，没一个守约的。玉已经到赵国了。”

quotes.name: 蔺相如
quotes.text: 秦国二十多个国君，没一个守约的。玉已经到赵国了。

lines.en: He says: "Qin has had twenty-odd rulers, and not one ever kept a deal. The jade is already in Zhao."
lines.source: 秦自繆公以來二十餘君，未嘗有堅明約束者也……故令人持璧歸，閒至趙矣

lines.text: “骗了大王，该死。把我下锅煮了吧。”

quotes.name: 蔺相如
quotes.text: 骗了大王，该死。把我下锅煮了吧。

lines.en: "I deceived Your Majesty. I deserve death. Throw me in the pot."
lines.source: 臣知欺大王之罪當誅，臣請就湯鑊

lines.text: 满朝大臣面面相觑，有人要拖他出去。
lines.en: The ministers stare at each other. Someone moves to drag him out.
lines.source: 秦王與群臣相視而嘻。左右或欲引相如去

lines.text: 秦王说：“杀了他，玉也回不来。放他回去吧。”

quotes.name: 秦王
quotes.text: 杀了他，玉也回不来。放他回去吧。

lines.en: The king says: "Kill him and we still don't get the jade. Let him go home."
lines.source: 今殺相如，終不能得璧也……不如因而厚遇之，使歸趙

lines.text: 最后，秦国没给城，赵国也没给玉。
lines.en: In the end, Qin never gave the cities. Zhao never gave the jade.
lines.source: 秦亦不以城予趙，趙亦終不予秦璧

lines.text: 价值连城的玉，一座城也没换到；倒是那个门客，回国就当了大官。
lines.en: A jade worth fifteen cities didn't get a single one. But the eunuch's retainer came home a senior official.
lines.source: 相如既歸，趙王以為賢大夫使不辱於諸侯，拜相如為上大夫
